competition.name: Kyler Murray
competition.status: Signed by Vikings in 2026 free agency after being released by the Arizona Cardinals (one-year deal; nfl.com headline describes it as a 'league minimum deal', while an msn.com headline separately calls it 'the biggest QB deal of the 2026 NFL offseason' -- conflicting characterizations, dollar amount not independently confirmed)
competition.note: As of Aug 9, 2026 (ESPN camp intel), Murray has been getting the MAJORITY of first-team reps in training camp over McCarthy. This is an active, real, ongoing QB competition -- HC Kevin O'Connell has not named a starter as of that date. This directly contradicts a 'McCarthy is just a backup on a stale depth chart' read; it is a genuine open competition with Murray currently ahead in reps.
